result:
Fleet check across 5 hosts:

| Host | Used % | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| host1 | 45% | OK |
| host2 | 38% | OK |
| host3 | **92%** | ⚠️ thin-provisioned, name "media-pool" |
| host4 | 22% | OK |
| host5 | 30% | OK |

**host3 is the one that needs attention.** 92% used is high on its own, but it being thin-provisioned makes it more urgent, not less — thin provisioning means the reported 92% is against the *logical/allocated* size, so actual backing storage could already be tighter than it looks, and if the underlying pool fills unexpectedly, writes can fail abruptly even though the volume itself doesn't show 100%. Worth checking the actual physical pool utilization behind "media-pool" and setting an alert threshold before it hits capacity.

Everything else is comfortably under 50%.
